# Official PhysioNet/CinC 2019 evaluation code

This directory contains an unmodified copy of `evaluate_sepsis_score.py` from
`physionetchallenges/evaluation-2019` commit
`467c49b514542be7a4a0bafe40fa2c3b064dda2e` (BSD-2-Clause).

Source SHA-256: `26b8b26267ed32e8b7a7a27e45201cfc8c6640e717ba4cdc1f452b32f12b99e5`.

The pipeline calls this scorer directly; it must not gain a second local
implementation of Challenge Utility.
